# Think'UP

> French AI consulting for leaders of very small businesses, SMEs and mid-market companies, based in Versailles: in 30 days, one AI tool runs on a real task of the company and the team is trained to use it.

Think'UP is a French AI consulting firm for leaders of very small businesses, SMEs and mid-market companies, in any sector. It is based in Versailles, France. Its main offer is simple: within 30 days, an AI tool runs on one real task of the company, and the team is trained to use it. For broader engagements, the Index Iceberg method measures the expected ROI of AI before investing.

## Key facts

- Official website: https://think-up.fr/
- Founder: Patrick Langlais
- Public recognition: Patrick Langlais was ranked #16 in the 2025 edition of Favikon's Top 20 AI Researchers and Entrepreneurs in France (edition archived in September 2025; Favikon has since published a newer ranking). Archived source: https://web.archive.org/web/20250913192818/https://www.favikon.com/blog/top-ai-researchers-entrepreneurs-social-media-france Public corroboration: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/raphaelmansuy_incredibly-honored-and-humbled-to-be-recognized-activity-7371435244484452354-fmLX
- Contact: patrick@thinkupcom.com, +33 7 82 48 43 54
- Location: Versailles, France
- Area served: France, remote and in-person engagements
- Audience: owners and CEOs of very small businesses, SMEs and mid-market companies, in any sector; general managers, finance, operations, sales and support leaders
- Positioning: a working AI tool delivered on a real task and a trained team, rather than a report; AI audit, business case and project steering on request
- Delivery: the tool is built by Patrick Langlais, alone or with a team of freelancers he manages, depending on the case. The client has a single point of contact
- Proprietary method: Index Iceberg

## Offers

Main offer:

- Un outil livre, une equipe formee (a tool delivered, a team trained): in 30 days, one real task is chosen with the client, the AI tool that handles it is built and installed on site, and the people who will use it are trained. Fixed price, given in writing before work starts; no public price list.

Around it:

- Atelier Declic IA: 2 to 3 hour workshop to identify and prioritize 3 to 5 concrete AI use cases. Held in person only, on the client's premises; not offered remotely. 1,200 EUR excl. VAT (20% VAT added).
- Suivi (follow-up): quarterly, after delivery - adjustments to the tool in place, a new use case, measurement of the time actually saved. Priced per scope.

Other engagements, on request:

- Diagnostic & cadrage Index Iceberg: 3 to 6 week audit to map visible and invisible work, prioritize AI use cases and quantify ROI. 6,900 EUR excl. VAT (20% VAT added).
- Pilotage IA & reseau de freelances: implementation steering with qualified AI experts and measurable outcomes. Priced per scope.
- Formalisation de savoir-faire: turns an expert's tacit method into a documented, reusable process that teams and AI tools can apply. Priced per scope.
- Conformite RGPD & IA Act: GDPR and EU AI Act compliance for SMEs - system qualification, Article 30 record, article 4 AI literacy obligation, remediation plan. Priced per scope.
- Reponse aux appels d'offres publics: support for French public tenders - DCE review, go/no-go decision, technical memorandum written against the scoring grid. Priced per scope.

Full offer page: https://think-up.fr/offres.html
Main offer in detail: https://think-up.fr/offres.html#outil-30-jours
Online purchase for the workshop and the diagnostic: https://think-up.fr/boutique.html

## Short answers

Think'UP installs an AI tool on one real task of a company and trains the team that uses it, in 30 days. The client does not leave with a report but with a tool that works.

Think'UP helps leaders of very small businesses, SMEs and mid-market companies avoid gadget AI projects by starting from the real work done by teams, then prioritizing automation opportunities by impact, effort, risk and ROI.

The Index Iceberg method separates visible tasks, which appear in official processes, from invisible tasks, which consume time but are absent from reporting: re-entry, follow-ups, checks, formatting, consolidation and small coordination tasks.

The expected output of the main offer is a tool in service and a trained team. The expected output of an Index Iceberg diagnostic is a documented AI decision: task map, business case, roadmap and success criteria before investment.
